sys.path.insert(0,str(q));from build import run,env,s,n,root
for _ in range(3600):
 if (q/'fixed.json').exists():break
 time.sleep(1)
else:raise TimeoutError('fixed controls')
lib=s/'coaptic/src/lib.rs';origlib=lib.read_bytes();assoc=s/'coaptic/src/app/associations.rs'
example=n/'servers/src/bin/fixed-read.rs'
code=(q/'fixed-read.rs').read_text().replace('let begin=Instant::now();','coaptic::slot_visits(); let begin=Instant::now();').replace('println!("{A} {large} {n} {elapsed}");','println!("{A} {large} {n} {elapsed} {}", coaptic::slot_visits());')
example.write_text(code)
lib.write_bytes(origlib+b'\npub(crate) static SLOT_VISITS: core::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize = core::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0);\n#[doc(hidden)] pub fn slot_visits() -> usize { SLOT_VISITS.swap(0,core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) }\n')
def marked(t):
 # The slice primitive yields the same row reference. Each visited row increments one process-local counter.
 t,k=re.subn(r'(\bself\s*\.\s*rows\s*\.\s*iter(?:_mut)?\(\))',r'\1.inspect(|_| { crate::SLOT_VISITS.fetch_add(1, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed); })',t)
 t,first=re.subn(r'(\bself\s*\.\s*rows\s*\.\s*first(?:_mut)?\(\))',r'\1.inspect(|_| { crate::SLOT_VISITS.fetch_add(1, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed); })',t)
 assert k>=8 and first>=2,(k,first)
 return t
try:
 for arm in ('control','candidate'):
  for name in ['src/app/'+i for i in ('associations.rs','mod.rs','oscore.rs')]:
   data=((q/('frozen-'+Path(name).name)).read_bytes() if arm=='candidate' else sp.check_output(['git','show','9c632ba:'+name]))
   if name.endswith('associations.rs'):data=marked(data.decode()).encode()
   (s/'coaptic'/name).write_bytes(data)
  run('count-'+arm,['build','--offline','--locked','--release','--manifest-path',str(n/'Cargo.toml'),'-p','bench-rust-server','--bin','fixed-read'])
  shutil.copyfile(Path(env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])/'release/fixed-read.exe',q/('count-'+arm+'.exe'))
finally:
 lib.write_bytes(origlib)
 for name in ['src/app/'+i for i in ('associations.rs','mod.rs','oscore.rs')]:shutil.copyfile(q/('frozen-'+Path(name).name),s/'coaptic'/name)
rows=[]
for rep in range(6):
 for arm,slots,size in list(itertools.product(('control','candidate'),[1,32],['small','large']))[::1 if rep%2==0 else -1]:
  for variant in (('fixed','count') if rep%2==0 else ('count','fixed')):
   count=30000; fields=sp.check_output([str(q/(variant+'-'+arm+'.exe')),str(slots),size,str(count)],text=True).strip().split()
   assert int(fields[2])==count
   rows.append(dict(rep=rep,arm=arm,slots=slots,size=size,variant=variant,ns=int(fields[3])/count,visits=int(fields[4])/count if len(fields)==5 else None))
(q/'counts.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=1))
for arm,slots,size in itertools.product(('control','candidate'),[1,32],['small','large']):
 rr=[r for r in rows if (r['arm'],r['slots'],r['size'])==(arm,slots,size)]
 plain=[r['ns'] for r in rr if r['variant']=='fixed'];meter=[r['ns']for r in rr if r['variant']=='count']
 print(arm,slots,size,set(r['visits'] for r in rr if r['visits'] is not None),'overhead_percent',round(statistics.median(100*(v/u-1)for u,v in zip(plain,meter)),1))
